name: Chiryū (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chiryū city emblem in purple: a stylised device of a lozenge above a book-like shape.
history: Municipal flag of Chiryū, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1970.

features.role: Chiryū city emblem — a stylised device of a lozenge above a book-like shape
